Diagnose electrical installation and identify problems including: bad connections, incorrect wiring, high loop impedance and equipment failure

Rewire and repair faulty installations

text.en: Positive isolation before work: isolate the equipment or system as per the given standards, lock it out and confirm it is dead before touching any conductor.
text.hi: काम शुरू करने से पहले उपकरण को मानक अनुसार पूरी तरह आइसोलेट करें, लॉक लगाएं और मृत (dead) प्रमाणित करें।

text.en: Wear the PPE suited to the task and hazard: insulated gloves, helmet, goggles, safety boots, and insulated tools.
text.hi: कार्य और खतरे के अनुसार PPE पहनें: इंसुलेटेड दस्ताने, हेलमेट, गॉगल, सेफ्टी बूट और इंसुलेटेड औजार।

text.en: Rescue from live parts: do not touch the victim with bare hands; isolate the supply first or push the conductor away with a dry non-conducting object.
text.hi: लाइव हिस्से से बचाव: पीड़ित को नंगे हाथ से न छुएं; पहले सप्लाई बंद करें या सूखी गैर-चालक वस्तु से तार हटाएं।

text.en: Electric shock can cause cardiac arrest; administer basic first aid including CPR immediately and call for medical help.
text.hi: बिजली के झटके से हृदय रुक सकता है; तुरंत CPR सहित प्राथमिक उपचार दें और डॉक्टर बुलाएं।

text.en: Match the extinguisher to the fire class: Class A solids, Class B flammable liquids/gases, Class C electrical equipment (per ESSC ELE/N1002), Class D metals.
text.hi: आग के प्रकार के अनुसार सही अग्निशामक लगाएं: क्लास A ठोस, क्लास B ज्वलनशील तरल/गैस, क्लास C विद्युत उपकरण, क्लास D धातुएं।

text.en: Use proper scaffolds, elevated platforms and ladders for work at height; never work on heights without stable access.
text.hi: ऊंचाई पर काम के लिए उचित स्कैफोल्ड, ऊंचा मंच और सीढ़ी का ही प्रयोग करें; स्थिर साधन के बिना ऊंचाई पर काम न करें।

text.en: Follow warning signs and symbols: danger plate, high voltage area, out of service markers before approaching any installation.
text.hi: चेतावनी संकेतों का पालन करें: खतरा प्लेट, हाई वोल्टेज क्षेत्र, आउट ऑफ़ सर्विस चिह्न।

text.en: Test before touch: verify insulation resistance, earth continuity and polarity with proper instruments before energizing any installation.
text.hi: छूने से पहले जांचें: ऊर्जादान से पहले इंसुलेशन रेजिस्टेंस, अर्थ कंटिन्यूटी और पोलैरिटी जांच लें।

text.en: Verify earthing (plate/pipe) and the correct rating and functioning of fuse, MCB and RCCB - these save lives.
text.hi: अर्थिंग (प्लेट/पाइप) और फ्यूज़, MCB, RCCB की सही रेटिंग व कार्यशीलता जांचें - यही जीवन बचाते हैं।

text.en: Fuse, switch or circuit breaker must be wired only in the phase conductor, never in the earthed neutral conductor.
text.hi: फ्यूज़, स्विच या सर्किट ब्रेकर केवल फेज कंडक्टर में लगाएं, अर्थड न्यूट्रल में कभी नहीं।

text.en: Apply standard safe working practices in confined areas, trenches and while handling electrical equipment.
text.hi: संकीर्ण स्थानों, खाइयों और विद्युत उपकरणों के साथ काम में मानक सुरक्षा विधियां अपनाएं।

text.en: Check tools and tackles before use - insulation intact, no damage; keep them in safe and usable condition.
text.hi: उपयोग से पहले औजार जांचें - इंसुलेशन सही और कोई क्षति नहीं; उन्हें सुरक्षित और उपयोगी स्थिति में रखें।

text.en: Keep the work area clean and free of hazards before and after the job; store flammable materials safely to prevent accidental fire.
text.hi: काम से पहले और बाद में क्षेत्र साफ और खतरा-रहित रखें; ज्वलनशील सामग्री सुरक्षित रखें।

text.en: Know the emergency procedure: raise the alarm, evacuate safely to the assembly point, roll call and only then return to work.
text.hi: आपात प्रक्रिया जानें: अलार्म बजाएं, सुरक्षित असेंबली पॉइंट पर पहुंचें, उपस्थिति दर्ज कराएं, तभी काम पर लौटें।

text.en: Dispose e-waste (lead, cadmium, flame retardant plastics) by approved methods and follow ESD procedures while handling electronics.
text.hi: ई-वेस्ट (सीसा, कैडमियम) को स्वीकृत विधि से निपटाएं और इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स संभालते समय ESD नियम पालन करें।

text.en: Report any abnormal situation of equipment or an accident without delay and write the incident report for the authorized person.
text.hi: उपकरण की असामान्य स्थिति या दुर्घटना की तुरंत सूचना दें और घटना रिपोर्ट लिखें।

prompt.en: Before any work begins on a circuit that has been switched off, what must the electrician confirm as per PSS/N1331?

text.en: That the switch is in the off position only
Positive isolation of the electrical equipment and system as per the given standards
That the customer has been informed verbally
That a neon tester glows when touched

explanation.en: PSS/N1331 PC5 requires positive isolation of electrical equipment and system as per the given standards - switching off alone is not isolation.

prompt.en: As per PSS/N6002, where may a fuse, switch or circuit breaker be placed?

text.en: Only in the phase conductor, never in the earthed neutral conductor
In both phase and neutral conductors

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC16: fuse, switch or circuit breaker should not be placed in an earthed neutral conductor and are wired only in the phase conductor.

prompt.en: Why are protective devices (fuse, MCB, RCCB) required on a domestic circuit?

text.en: To increase the load capacity of the wiring
To save the lives of human beings, livestock and animals by interrupting fault current
To change the polarity of the circuit

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC15: all protective devices must function properly as they are necessary to save the lives of human beings, livestock and animals.

prompt.en: In ESSC NOS ELE/N1002, which fire class covers fires in electrical equipment such as appliances, wiring and breaker panels?

explanation.en: ELE/N1002 PC11: Class A ordinary solid combustibles, Class B flammable liquids and gases, Class C electrical equipment such as appliances, wiring, breaker panels.

prompt.en: A victim of electric shock is in cardiac arrest. What must the electrician do?

text.en: Administer basic first aid including CPR immediately
Massage the chest gently and wait
Wait for the ambulance without acting

explanation.en: PSS/N1331 PC17 and ELE/N1002 PC14 require prompt action with basic first aid including CPR for cardiac arrest due to electric shock.

prompt.en: A person is in contact with a live conductor. What is the rescuer's first correct action?

text.en: Pull the person away with bare hands
Isolate the supply and use a dry non-conducting object before touching the person
Call out but do not approach at all

explanation.en: Safe rescue requires isolation of the supply first; touching a live victim with bare hands electrocutes the rescuer too (PSS/N1331 safe working practices).

prompt.en: PSS/N1331 PC1 requires protective clothing and equipment to be selected for:

text.en: The specific task and work conditions
Only when the supervisor is present

explanation.en: PSS/N1331 PC1: use protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work conditions; ELE/N1002 PC3 adds severity of hazard and Indian/International standards.

prompt.en: Before energizing a new installation, which test set does ELE/N5805 PC1 require?

text.en: Insulation resistance and earth continuity tests, correct polarity and a complete visual inspection

explanation.en: ELE/N5805 PC1: test installations before energizing for personal and electrical safety - insulation resistance, earth continuity, correct polarity and complete visual inspection.

prompt.en: Which of these is listed as a warning sign to be followed while working with electrical systems?

explanation.en: PSS/N1331 PC4 lists warning signs such as danger plate, high voltage area and out of service while working with electrical systems.

prompt.en: PSS/N1331 PC8 specifically requires for working at height:

text.en: Proper scaffolds, elevated platforms and ladders
Holding the ceiling fan while working

explanation.en: PSS/N1331 PC8: use proper scaffolds, elevated platforms and ladders for working at height.

prompt.en: Which instrument is used to check earth resistance of a house wiring installation as per PSS/N6002 PC28?

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC28 requires operating instruments to check earth resistance; the earth tester (0-30 ohm) is the specified instrument.

prompt.en: Which option best matches PSS/N6001 PC10, implement methods of protection against electric shock?

text.en: Insulation of live parts, earthing of exposed conductive parts and protective devices

explanation.en: PSS/N6001 PC10 covers methods of protection against electric shock: insulation, earthing and protective devices - not conductor sizing or fuse rating changes.

prompt.en: What does a 500 V megger measure in house wiring?

text.en: Insulation resistance of live conductors to earth and between conductors

explanation.en: PSS/N6001 PC9 and PSS/N6002 PC26: insulation resistance of all live conductors to earth and between live conductors is measured with the insulation megger.

prompt.en: A tong tester / clamp meter is used to:

text.en: Measure current without breaking the circuit

explanation.en: Clamp on meter measures current flowing in a conductor by clamping around it, without breaking the circuit (PSS/N6003 measuring instruments).

prompt.en: A neon tester is used to check:

text.en: Presence of phase voltage on a conductor

explanation.en: The neon tester (listed in KU10 of PSS/N6002 along with test lamp, multimeter, clamp on meter and meggers) indicates whether a conductor is live.

prompt.en: Which instrument checks continuity, open circuit, short circuit and load flow in house wiring?

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC27: operate instruments to check continuity, open circuit, short circuit and load flow - done with a multi meter.

prompt.en: What is the correct use of a wire stripper?

text.en: Remove insulation without nicking the conductor

explanation.en: The wire stripper (DGT trainee toolkit item 19) strips insulation cleanly so the conductor is not nicked, which would weaken it and cause overheating.

prompt.en: A crimping tool is used while forming circuits to:

text.en: Terminate wires on lugs/connectors for secure component connections

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC12: join and connect wire to fixtures and components to form circuits - crimped lug joints are made with the crimping tool (DGT toolkit items 43/44).

prompt.en: A phase sequence meter is used to check:

text.en: Phase rotation of a three phase supply

explanation.en: ELE/N5805 PC2: energized testing includes correct voltage and phase rotation, checked with a phase sequence meter (DGT toolkit item 150).

prompt.en: In appliance repair, a soldering iron is used to:

text.en: Solder winding wires, cables and their joints

explanation.en: PSS/N6003 PC19: solder winding wires, cables and their joints in electrical gadgets; DGT toolkit lists 25 W, 65 W and 125 W soldering irons.

prompt.en: Ohm's law relates voltage, current and resistance as:

explanation.en: Voltage equals current times resistance (PSS/N6001 KU3: basic elements of electricity - voltage, current, resistance, power, energy).

prompt.en: Which accessory mainly protects occupants from earth leakage / shock current in a house wiring circuit?

explanation.en: PSS/N6001 PC3/KU7 cover ratings and functioning of fuses, switches, sockets, MCBs and ELCBs/RCDs - the RCCB/ELCB is the earth-leakage protective device.

prompt.en: PSS/N6001 PC15 requires that all switches in a wiring installation be connected in:

explanation.en: PSS/N6001 PC15: check polarity to ensure all switches are connected in phase conductors, so the load is dead when switched off.

prompt.en: Insulation resistance is measured between:

text.en: All live conductors to earth and between live conductors

explanation.en: PSS/N6001 PC9: insulation resistance of all live conductors to earth and insulation resistance between live conductors.

prompt.en: In a single phase motor, the starting condenser is used to:

text.en: Help develop the rotating field so the motor starts

explanation.en: PSS/N6003 PC5 and PC6: operating principle of single phase motor, use of condenser and how a rotating field is developed in single phase and three phase motors.

prompt.en: The two types of earthing layout understood for house wiring as per PSS/N6002 PC20 are:

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC20: understand types of earthing - plate and pipe earthing layout location (KU5: standard procedure to lay pipe and plate earthing).

prompt.en: In large residential and commercial units, the load on three phase wiring should be:

text.en: Equally distributed across the three phases

explanation.en: PSS/N6001 PC16: check equal distribution of load on three phase wiring in large residential and commercial units.

prompt.en: PSS/N6002 PC18 requires cables to be chosen for correct type, size and:

text.en: Current-carrying capacity to bear the load

explanation.en: PSS/N6002 PC18: ensure that the correct type, size and current-carrying capacity of cables is chosen to bear the load.

title.en: Safety knowledge check (isolation, PPE, rescue, fire)

brief.en: Answer the safety questions drawn from PSS/N1331 and ELE/N1002. A failed critical-safety item vetoes the overall pass.
Identify what each instrument measures and answer basic electrical theory questions.

title.en: Identify the hand tools for house wiring

brief.en: From a presented set, pick the hand tools required for wiring work and reject the distractors.
Pick the correct instrument for insulation, continuity, earth resistance, current and phase sequence checks.

title.en: Safe isolation and PPE checklist before starting work

brief.en: Confirm each isolation and PPE step performed before touching any circuit. Built from the safety performance criteria.

title.en: House wiring fault-finding and connection checklist

brief.en: Walk through the inspection steps for locating faults, checking polarity and confirming connections.

title.en: Photograph the isolation, warning and earthing setup at the worksite

brief.en: Take photos showing the locked-out isolation point, warning signage, PPE worn, the phase-only switching arrangement and the earthing connection before any work begins.

title.en: Video: install and test protective devices and measure insulation

brief.en: Record the installation of fuse/MCB/RCCB as per load, the tightened colour-coded connections, and the insulation resistance and continuity tests before handing over.

title.en: Video: preventive maintenance and repair of a household appliance

brief.en: Record the isolation, inspection of tripping/isolating devices, cleaning and part replacement of a household gadget, ending with grounding verification and insulation measurement.

title.en: Narrate the electric-shock rescue and first-aid procedure

brief.en: Explain aloud how you would rescue a victim in contact with a live part, isolate the supply, give first aid including CPR, and write the incident report.

title.en: Narrate your fault-diagnosis walkthrough of a failed lighting circuit

brief.en: Talk through locating the blown fuse / MCB trip / short circuit, checking for overheated switches and loose contacts, verifying polarity, and when to escalate an unclear fault.

levelBands.label: NSQF Level 3 - performs routine domestic wiring tasks with limited choice, works to established procedures
NSQF Level 4 - master technician, analyses and resolves non-routine wiring and fault-finding problems
NSQF Level 5 - junior technical supervisor, leads a small team and takes responsibility for complex diagnostics

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Safe isolation, LOTO and PPE discipline

suggestion.en: Practise positive isolation with lockout on a distribution board and repeat PPE selection for each work condition until it is habit.
suggestion.hi: डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन बोर्ड पर लॉकआउट सहित सकारात्मक आइसोलेशन का अभ्यास करें और हर कार्य स्थिति के लिए PPE चयन दोहराएं।

bridgeTraining.skillArea: Protective devices, earthing and phase-only switching

suggestion.en: Drill on rating selection for fuse/MCB/RCCB as per load, plate and pipe earthing layouts, and verifying that every switch and fuse is in the phase conductor only.

Build confidence with megger, earth tester, multimeter and clamp meter: run the full pre-energisation test sequence (insulation resistance, earth continuity, polarity, visual inspection) and locate common faults.
Repeat preventive maintenance on fans, pumps and geysers: isolation check, tripping device status, cleaning, part replacement and motor winding insulation measurement.
